جَوَّالٌ One who goes about, or round about, much, or often, in the countries, or districts, (Msb,) TA,) not remaining fixed, or settled; (Msb;) as also ↓ جَوَّالَةٌ [but in a more intensive sense, meaning who does so very much, or very often]. (TA.) ―
-b2- A horse having a flexible head: (TA:) and ↓ أَجْوَلِىٌّ a swift horse, that turns about howsoever one turns him. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
